2.0.0: Updated to Facebook Graph API v25.0.
Removed deprecated fbgraph and bluebird dependencies — uses native fetch via context.httpRequest.
Updated OAuth scopes: manage_pages → pages_manage_posts/pages_read_engagement, publish_pages → pages_manage_posts.
Removed FindPlace component (Place Search API was removed from Graph API).
Modernized all components to use shared FacebookClient utility.
Removed NewPost (feed) component — user_posts permission was removed by Facebook.
2.1.0: Added test() (Flow Test Mode) to the NewPagePost trigger.
2.2.1: Added MakeApiCall component for performing arbitrary authorized API calls to the Facebook Graph API.
2.2.2: NewPagePost: the page picker is now a typeahead text field, so a value can still be entered when the list fails to load; added output schemas with examples.
2.2.4: MakeApiCall: Request Headers and Query Parameters set in the Designer are now sent. They were silently dropped: the key-value field stores its rows as a JSON object string, which the component did not parse.
2.3.0: Added Find Page Posts: reads the posts of a page you manage, with an optional time range and a result limit, including their attachments (photos, videos, links). Uses the scopes the connector already requests.
Create Page Post: new Images input attaches up to 10 photos, each from a file or a public URL; the post outputs their Photo IDs.
Create Page Post: the Page field accepts a typed-in Page ID when the page list fails to load.
